title: INTERPRETATION
author: Sanghamitra Devi
text:
A propaganda of his associations...
Vibrantly aflamed rumors.....
Doesn’t like pivot fade.....
Creates hollowness beyond serpentine
Erotic suckling love equipoises
Can’t cuddle deep into her moaning soul...
Transformative warm hormones....
Had once tossed off- shores.
Hadn’t he trespassed her innocent psychic goal....
Hadn’t the gossips heralding howls threatened her soul...
This stinging recollection terribly withers her smile
Although the castration is mysteriously corrosive...
Insignificantly charming an alchemist she is...
Can’t she challenge it by emeritus expurgation ???
Hooded in adulteration of bewitching lies and....
Overcome the chained polymerization of such......
‘A Fallacious Interpretation
